scope: Independent static review and frozen-byte cross-check. Read original failure and already executed local logs; no rerun of local suites or native Windows/CI.

nativeTraceReview.fields: Fixed event/cause labels, HRESULT/status numbers, process ID, document/navigation epochs, readiness/foreground/minimized flags, runtime version and fixed document-state observations. No environment, command line, query URL, preferences or exception context copied into JSONL.
nativeTraceReview.cancellation: Same original native input-disable and suspend calls. Diagnostic expression records the actual executing document and invokes original suspend exactly once. Observation exceptions are caught before cancellation; original suspend exceptions still propagate. No QA/model/controller snapshot consumption.

ownProcessObservationReview.deadlineQualification: Checks deadline between callbacks; an admitted WM_GETTEXT call has its own 100ms bound. This is bounded observation, not a claim of exactly three seconds including every OS call.

preFreezeReviewIssuesResolved: Removed new HRESULT-based fail branches and diagnostic retry state changes, keeping this change observational.
Removed arbitrary exception/reason strings from trace records; original UI error text remains unchanged.
Guarded document-property observation so failure cannot prevent the existing suspend action; exact expression regression covers it.
remainingLimitations: Original Pon no-state initialization and Back navigation cancellation causes remain unproven.
Native JSONL timing/phase evidence and own-process window observation still require an actual Windows run.
Local C++/injected WinAPI/JS tests do not establish MSVC compilation or WebView2 runtime success.
